summary_1line: After their wedding, Siva and Parvati dwell in love at Kailasa while the gods seek help against Taraka, leading to the miraculous birth of Skanda.

image_candidates.scene_text: Siva and Parvati dance joyfully among peacocks in a secluded arbor on Mount Kailasa.
The radiant six‑headed infant Skanda appears at dawn amid Vedic chants while gods shower flowers from the sky.
Nandi stands guard outside the bedchamber of Siva and Parvati on the shining slopes of silver Mount Kailasa.
